M-006.why: The storefront contains only placeholder listings with no descriptions, no prices, and generic titles, and every policy page is unedited template text. There is no evidence to assess what this merchant sells or whether the business is real. This is a documentation gap under review_criteria.md Section 3.1.
M-006.request:
We cannot complete review of your application with the information currently available. Please provide:

1. A complete product catalog with real listing titles, descriptions and prices for the items you intend to sell through this account.

2. Storefront pages written for your business — your current About page, refund policy and shipping policy contain only template placeholder text and must be replaced with your actual business information.

3. A specific description of your business in the application record beyond "Specialty retail storefront" — what products or product categories do you sell?

Once we receive this information we can continue processing your application.

M-011.request:
We require the following documentation before we can complete our review of your application:

1. **Bank account registration clarification.** Your application lists the bank account name as "K.P. Holdings Ltd." but the registered business name is "Kestrel Provisions Inc." Please provide documentation explaining this relationship — for example, a certificate of incorporation for the holding entity showing its ownership of the operating company, or bank records confirming the account is registered to Kestrel Provisions Inc. under a trading name structure.

2. **Projected volume substantiation.** Your stated projected monthly volume of $185,000 appears high relative to your catalog scale (10 items, average ticket $47). This would require approximately 3,936 transactions per month. Please provide documentation supporting this projection — for example, sales records from another sales channel, a wholesale contract, or a detailed volume forecast showing the transaction basis for the projection.

3. **Tax identification confirmation.** Your tax ID status is marked as pending. Please provide your completed tax identification documentation.

Please submit these items through your merchant dashboard. We will complete our review within 2 business days of receipt.
